notes.text: Do not retry refresh with same refresh_token after timeout without Idempotency-Key. Keyline rotates tokens and treats reuse as theft (docs/vendor/authserver-api.md §10.2), revoking whole family and signing out all devices. Safe retry requires same Idempotency-Key (§11).

notes.text: refreshSession must not clear TokenStore on TransportError (ETIMEDOUT/ECONNRESET). Request may never have reached server so stored tokens stay valid; clearing logs user out on single blip. Throw AuthError network and keep session.

notes.text: FakeTokenServer never invalidates old refresh_tokens and has no family revocation, unlike Keyline rotation + reuse detection (§10.2). Retries that pass here can still revoke whole family in prod; do not trust it for retry safety.
